AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MAY 19, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE
PROVISIONS OF THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND TELECONFERENCED. TO PARTICIPATE IN A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN
EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR DIAL INTO THE GOTOMEETING AT (786) 535-3211 TO
SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. DETAILS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE CITY'S
WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393, which is also where the meeting
may be viewed.
  6:00 PM
  VIA TELECONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING - 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNCIL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957: THREAT
  TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles County
  Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: APN 8056-017-901; Negotiating Parties: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager, on behalf of the
  City and Penny Reeves, Norwalk Auto Auction; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  John Ramirez
  Director of Community Development

FLAG SALUTE
  Glen Kau
  Director of Public Services/City Engineer

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to recognize the week of May 18, 2020 as Public Works week.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Quarterly Update from the Chamber of Commerce.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES - Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of May 5
  and May 12, 2020. 825-04

  Minutes
   2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period April 5, 2020 – April 18,
  2020, in the total amount of $942,739.59. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period April
  29, through May 12, 2020, in the total amount of $1,561,418.53. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY - Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by William Watkins.
  830-23

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – MAY 13, 2020 - No action is required unless the City Council
  elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the Commission’s
  action was final. 320

  Synopsis

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-34 – APPROVING AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 6 – ADMITTING THE
  CITY OF PARAMOUNT TO THE WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION OF SOUTHEAST
  LOS ANGELES COUNTY, INC. – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-34, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING THE SIXTH
  AMENDED AND RESTATED JOINT EXERCISE OF POWERS AGREEMENT FOR THE SOUTHEAST
  LOS ANGELES COUNTY WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT BOARD (SELACO WDB) FOR
  WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES. 135-15

  Report

  7.  ACCEPT WORK – CITY HALL HEATING, VENTILATING, AND AIR CONDITIONING (HVAC) DUCT
  CLEANING - Staff recommends City Council approve the $32,500 for the additional City Hall HVAC
  duct cleaning and accept the work for the entire project performed by Action Duct Cleaning.

  Report

  8.  APPROVAL OF TRACT MAP NO. 82196, FOR AN INDUSTRIAL CONDOMINIUM SUBDIVISION
  LOCATED AT 15519-15537 BLACKBURN AVENUE, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-09 - Staff
  recommends City Council approve Tract Map No. 82196 conditioned on the execution of the
  improvement guarantee required by Norwalk Municipal Code Section 16.03.160. 320-06-82196

  Report

  9.  PROJECT NO. 7438 – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE FOR AN ADVANCED METERING INFRASTRUCTURE (AMI) SYSTEM INSTALLATION
  PROJECT – PHASE 2 - Staff recommends City Council approve the plans and specifications for the
  AMI installation project in the central, east, and the southeast service areas, authorize the
  advertisement of bids, and schedule a bid opening date of June 17, 2020. 1005-04-7438

  Report

  10. RESOLUTION NO. 20-37 - DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS – COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT AND PUBLIC SAFETY – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-37,
  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE
  DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT AND PUBLIC
  SAFETY DEPARTMENTS. 870-02

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  11. ADVISORY BODIES - Staff recommends City Councilmembers either re-appoint current Advisory Body
   members or make new appointments for two-year terms beginning April 1, 2020 through March 31,
  2022. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARINGS

  12. RESOLUTION NO. 20-33 - SETTING SEWER SERVICE CHARGE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 AND
  ORDERING THAT SUCH CHARGE BE COLLECTED ON THE TAX ROLL - Staff recommends City
  Council consider adopting Resolution No. 20-33, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING THE ANNUAL SEWER REPORT AND LEVYING AN ANNUAL
  SEWER SERVICE CHARGE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 13.14 OF THE
  NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE AND ORDERING THE ANNUAL SEWER SERVICE CHARGE TO BE
  COLLECTED ON THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TAX ROLL. 637

  Report

  13. RESOLUTION NO. 20-35 - SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ANNUAL
  ACTION PLAN AND CITIZEN PARTICIPATION PLAN AND RESOLUTION NO. 20-36 - BUDGET
  AMENDMENT - RECEIPT OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT CORONAVIRUS
  RESPONSE FUNDS - Staff recommends City Council adopt:

  a.  Resolution No. 20-35, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  APPROVING A SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FY 2019/20 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND
  CITIZEN PARTICIPATION PLAN, APPLICATION OF CARES ACT FUNDS, AND
  IMPLEMENTATION OF CDBG-CV, HOME, AND PERFORMANCE REPORT WAIVERS; and

  b.  Resolution No. 20-36, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED BUDGET TO
  APPROPRIATE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT CORONAVIRUS RESPONSE
  FUNDS FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, in the amount
  of $747,572. 315

  Report

REPORTS

  14. PROJECT NO. 7855 – AWARD OF CONTRACT – NORWALK BICYCLE MASTER PLAN - Staff
  recommends City Council award a contract to Kittelson & Associates, Inc. for professional engineering
  services to develop a comprehensive Norwalk Bicycle Master Plan for a term of June 1, 2020 through
  February 28, 2022 in an amount not to exceed $170,596; and authorize the City Manager to execute
  an agreement and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a
  form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7855

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated May 14, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
